events.name: Inauguration 2021-22 & Guest Lecture: "It's a Data-Driven World"
events.description: ACE was inaugurated for the academic year 2021-22 by Mr. Saisubramaniam Gopalakrishnan, an alumnus of the CSE 2015 batch and Research Engineer at Institute for Infocomm Research, Singapore. As part of the inauguration, he delivered a webinar titled 'It's a Data-Driven World' at 4 PM.

events.name: Womania 2022
events.description: ACE conducted 'Womania' for the girl students of the department to commemorate International Women's Day.

events.name: Guest Lecture: "Introduction to Data Analytics"
events.description: A guest lecture on 'Introduction to Data Analytics' was delivered by Mr. Sashank K, an alumnus of the CSE 2018 batch and Analytics Manager at Madstreet Den, Chennai.
